description: Confirmed user scope: full MCP client support for tools, resources, prompts, notifications, and connection lifecycle. ExMCP owns protocol and transports. Add paginated discovery, resource reads/templates, prompt retrieval/completion, endpoint ping/status, and a host-owned notification session with lease fencing and cleanup. Preserve safe tool writes and host callback ownership. No MCP server publication. Do not modify jido_mcp or ExMCP.
title: Complete Connect MCP capability coverage with ExMCP
